records.title: Block NTT/INTT: 16-coefficient blocks through four lazy layers per pass (from the ML-DSA-44 line)
On our C46 / rgr1_e5031abe: Keccak rounds and NTT/INTT blocks as called functions; account fits the 75% class budget (+0.72M)
On our C48 / rgr1_c4221431: Keccak rounds 1-14 two per call; k2 theta and w1_lanes called (-80K, fits 75% budget)
On rukafe0x mk_3ae3d577: g5 inline, split 512/128 box pops (shorter debug names), our cache table mk_790f1c30 + cold ball mk_4ff5f9db; binharold mk_3c0224a5; by @ardianreffa
On our mk_96568c3f (rukafe0x mk_3ae3d577 line): Keccak rounds two per call, further box-pop splits; binharold mk_3c0224a5 line; by @ardianreffa
On mk_b2e61741: setup-path bytes spent on one inline ki2s site (head/col_into/gap/hb/ball_scan size trades)
C51a: chunked multi_pop_front destructures + g5/theta inline (fits 75% budget)
C52: QUAD->QF nibble table + rb2 two-round Keccak calls (fits 75% budget)
C53: rb8b inline round after transition, rb2 tail call, rb1 removed (fits 75% budget)
On mk_f8b63084 (rukafe0x): crate-root wrapper for ntt_z's element frees 15.5K class bytes at zero gas, buys an inline ki2s site (ki2s idea from binharold mk_ff66a13f)
C55: setup panic-exit trims fund a second inlined ki2s site in vrow (fits 75% budget)
C56: fifteen ki2s stages of vrow run as five three-group calls
C57: named-struct results fund 64-wide ntt_z pops; z_hat loop removed
ML-DSA-87: 256-wide intt_row pops traded against 32-wide ntt_z pops
ML-DSA-87: named-struct pop elements fund wider ntt_z and row_groups pops
C62: row-sum/ZP/QH crate-root structs + setup inlining pay for two inline ya sites (fits 75% budget)
On mk_7614df6d (rukafe0x): bsr tests i==128 after each bstep; identity upcasts dropped at zero gas pay for two inline ya sites
C63 on mk_90b16f72: sign-shared butterfly twiddles (-15.9K class) pay for two inline ya sites (-3,200)
C64 on mk_3e8c5a1e: non-panicking hint row slices drop the per-row OMEGA check (-4,190)
C65 on mk_ec087b83: hint trailing-zero check on packed chunks instead of bytes (-7.3K held-out)
C66 on mk_c437c2b8: zero hint chunks past the last end skip byte splitting (-10.9K held-out)
On mk_95787ead (rukafe0x): w1_block's hint paths each return from an inline helper, so a lane joins once instead of at four nested levels (-23,600 bench)
On mk_77b33694: SampleInBall's occupied-position paths bump the index themselves and go straight to the common join (-12,060 bench, -9,950 on average)
On mk_a88afbe2: reuse constant cells in grp1, bits, sig_decode and bsr (-30,200 bench)
On mk_f0546c01 (rukafe0x): w1_lanes appends a row's eight lanes after its last block, so the lane array is not re-stored after every append (-5,600)
On mk_5bab2335: the hint path's two divisors reach vrow as a parameter and bit_at divides by the cell bstep already holds (-5,760 bench)
On mk_84364599 (lyskey1): w1_lane block tests by downcast to BoundedInt<0,base-1> instead of u32 compares (-14,900 bench)
Hint path: skip redundant cross-block order check, bounded-difference order checks in w1_lane and more_hints
HPC powers as u64 (class reclaim), more_hints two positions per step, ya inlined at all ntt_z sites
Row ends popped from the hint, columns passed unsliced, trailing cache felts read by slice and pops
Fewer bounds-checked glue reads: one cache slice, row ends as [u8;8], z pair popped, exact masked split
On mk_9f0d3ed5: hint tail zero-check on the chunk branch, tail_zero call removed
On mk_d9503639: exact-count split of the last hint position chunk
On mk_1ca901aa: packed hint row lengths and c_tilde tail reuse
On mk_ed6f1de7: known-outcome branch removal (lanes8 bound, offset pops, th0 rotation)
ML-DSA-87: x2 Keccak recursion without stale loop state, th0 rotations checked
ML-DSA-87: peel the first more_hints step out of the recursion
